About me

I’m Akshay, a DevOps engineer and product builder based in Goa, India.

I enjoy the full arc of building: understanding a problem, making the technical decisions, and getting something useful into production. My work brings together cloud infrastructure, delivery systems, and AI tools.

I currently work at Siemens, where I operate cloud and on-prem platforms and mentor two interns. Before that, I worked at Zaggle on infrastructure and deployment automation across multiple business verticals.

My independent projects let me explore those interests further. Lemma brings AI agents to cloud operations; eksp examines the foundations of a scalable Kubernetes platform.
